headline: Nvidia Is Up 18% YTD — This SpaceX-Linked Chip Stock Is Up 190%
summary: STMicroelectronics has soared about 190% this year as AI data-center demand accelerates and investors take notice of its long-standing Starlink relationship ahead of SpaceX's anticipated IPO.

headline: Broadcom's AI Revenue Doubled — And It May Not Even Be Halfway Done
summary: Broadcom's AI chip sales are growing rapidly, with a projected $40 billion in revenue this fiscal year and a $73 billion backlog.
